exit 0

call flush: 200 [X-C=3] c=true d=false
call replace: 200 [Content-Type=text/x-late] f=true
h1 write: 200 [X-A=1 Content-Type=text/plain; charset=utf-8] a=true bad=false b=false
h1 flush: 200 [X-C=3] c=true d=false
h1 nobody: 204 [X-E=5]

h1 duplex: 200 [] g=false 7
h1 late: 200 [Content-Type=text/plain; charset=utf-8 X-H=8] h=true 7
h2 write: 200 [X-A=1 Content-Type=text/plain; charset=utf-8] a=true bad=false b=false
h2 flush: 200 [X-C=3] c=true d=false
h2 nobody: 204 [X-E=5]

h2 duplex: 200 [] g=false 7
h2 late: 200 [Content-Type=text/plain; charset=utf-8 X-H=8] h=true 7
